original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed premise of the fixed F0/B1 observation obstruction. Show exactly which query is recovered, legal native reads and restoration, and a full favorable budget including cover maps, helpers and endpoints. Local inverse identities alone do not close the global controller. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. stop_rule: Stop after an exact matching lower bound and constructive tariff on all 112 labels, source and phase controls, registered replay and scoped handoff; stop without expansion if source bindings or the construction fail.
